svg.title: Four-Bit Wonder Machine Autonomous Version socket layout
svg.desc: Approximate scaled DIP socket plan for the independent Four-Bit Wonder new-board base machine and Phase 1 and 2 additions.
svg.text: Independent new-board core: 28 sockets. Conceptual 0.1-inch grid; confirm final board dimensions before fabrication.

g.text: Grid is a drafting reference only; pin 1 is amber. Keep bulk capacitors at rails and 100nF decouplers at IC sockets.
